fusions.name: Unyielding Shove
fusions.desc: A strike with your weapon that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Grey Breath
fusions.desc: Breathes the cold off your shell into the cone ahead of you, which deals 28 damage to everything in it and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Cold and Unmoved
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Grey Carapace
fusions.desc: Conjures cold iron over your shell: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by a further 4%.
